description.ja: フジテレビ系列にて絶賛放映中の「ドラゴンボール改」に登場する「孫悟空」を界王拳Ver.で商品化。
description.en: "Son Goku " who appears in " Dragon Ball Kai" which is currently being aired on Fuji TV series has been commercialized as Kaioken version.

description.ja: ・対フリーザ戦を再現する衣装と赤い成形色で界王拳Ver.の孫悟空を忠実再現。
description.en: -Faithfully reproduces the Kaioken version of Son Goku with the costume and red molding color that reproduces the battle against Frieza.

description.ja: ・手と顔の表情パーツは各２種付属し、ポーズとともに劇中のアクションシーンを再現可能。
description.en: - Two types of hand and facial expression parts are included, allowing you to recreate action scenes from the movie along with poses.

description.ja: ・宙に浮いた状態でポージングできる クリアレッドのディスプレイスタンド付属。
description.en: - Comes with a clear red display stand that can be posed while floating in the air.

description.ja: ・戦闘時の姿を演出できるマーキングシール付属。
description.en: ・Comes with MarkingSeal that can be used to create a battle appearance.
